row.notes: CutSceneScript::setGarageLocation(script, garageIdx): garageIdx < 32 indexes the garage locator array [[0x14601f5c8]+0x98]+0x838+idx*8; when present refreshes it (0x142f62580) and copies its transform (locator+0x20) into the script (0x14024af00), returns 1; else WARN 'setGarageLocation %d failed', returns 0. The garage scene initialisers inline the same code with script+0x1e4 as index.
